versions.name: Bento 1.0.0
versions.changelog:
# 1.0.0 — First release

First public release. BentoMenu is a container-menu framework for Spigot, Paper and Folia: menus in YAML, themes players can switch, and an API for everything YAML can't reach.

## Added

- **Menus and layouts** — `menus/*.yml` holds content, `layouts/*.yml` holds shape (1–6 rows, border and content regions). Layouts are reusable across menus.
- **Four themes** — aurora, ember, mono and sakura, switchable at runtime. Theme and language choices persist per player.
- **Dynamic content** — pagination, category filters, anvil or chat search, and configurable refresh intervals.
- **Action chains** — player/console commands, economy withdraw/deposit, item give/take, open/close menu, page change, messages, titles, sounds and theme switching.
- **Conditions** — permission, balance, held items, server time, random chance, plus a registry for custom conditions from other plugins.
- **Cooldowns** — per-button, with configurable click debounce.
- **Text engine** — gradients, hex colors, tags and PlaceholderAPI placeholders wherever a player sees text.
- **Localization** — `zh_CN` and `en_US` included; every player-facing string lives in `messages/` and can be replaced wholesale.
- **Developer API** — `dev.bento.menu.api.v1` plus a Kotlin DSL, already shaded into the jar. Register menus, actions, conditions, data sources and themes; listen to open and close events.
- **Optional resource pack** — real gradient borders and custom icons when installed, stained-glass fallback when not.
- **Commands** — open, list, theme, language, close, info, reload, validate, stats.

## Compatibility

- Spigot 1.18.2, Paper 1.18.2 / 1.21.11 / 26.1.2 and Folia 1.21.8 passed functional tests.
- Paper and Folia 26.3 were verified up to startup and plugin enable.
- No NMS, no ProtocolLib, no client mods.
- Requires Java 17+, Vault (VaultUnlocked on Folia) and PlaceholderAPI.

## Performance

Measured with 200 mineflayer bots on a 4-core / 8 GB test machine:

- TPS 20.00 with 200 menus open.
- 2,225 clicks in 30 seconds: TPS 19.25–20.00.
- Average click handling 0.061 ms; average render 4.00 ms.
- 5,632 renders produced 38,680 item updates — no full-inventory resends.

## Known limitations

- Hybrid servers (Mohist, Arclight, …) are best-effort and untested here.
- 26.3 was only checked for startup; there is no mineflayer protocol for it yet.
- The resource pack must be delivered by the server owner.
- Some newer sound and material names fall back on 1.18 clients.

## Notes

- The API package `v1` is the stable surface; internal classes may change in later versions.
- An optional example addon is attached to this release.
- MIT licensed. Source, docs and issue tracker: https://github.com/chcucu/BentoMenu
